name: Diary Of My Love
source:
DIARY OF MY LOVE is a visual novel about the girl's diary, telling about her crushes. Sometimes not all love ends in a happy ending.

[from [url=https://aonika.itch.io/diary-of-my-love]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《我的爱的日记》是一部关于女孩日记的视觉小说，讲述了她的迷恋。有时候，并不是所有的爱情都会有美好的结局。

[来自[url=https://aonika.itch.io/diary-of-my-love]itch.io[/url]]
